sam: any early A/B numbers?

dena: fallback behavior: route-scoped immediate switch to last-stable (v5.1 fp16) and alert. if same route falls back >2x in 24h, auto-create P1.

maya: plan: run 2h quiet 0.5% at 06:00 UTC, sam to post slice diffs + rerank/halluc logs, then decide on staged ramp. console link: https://internal.redwood/console/rollouts/1748590000
